The five standard offers are covered; newly added feature variants are outside these holdouts, volume results and rare-event bounds. Bonanza uses another engine. Minimum bonus payments here apply only to House/LeXof.

rules.bonusMinimumNotice: A whole round with a bonus returns at least 5% of the equivalent bonus purchase price. The paid launch payout of a natural bonus counts toward this minimum. Any shortfall is a real separate bonus-payment frame, never an invented line/coin win.
rules.notice: Original Indictus rules inspired by documented bonus mechanics. Own prices and weights, disclosed whole-round cap of 40x base stake minus 1 AR; no provider mathematics or provider RTP claim. Free-spin payout tables are shared by natural and purchased bonuses for the same active tier. Paid tables are published separately. Each line, group or collected coin is rounded down to cents before the cap. Results never depend on balance or history.

maskhouse.legendaryNotice: Only a real paying line hood / WILD / WILD / WILD / hood can exceed the ordinary whole-round 25x budget or the ordinary free-spin 2.6x budget. That line awards the remaining amount up to 40x base stake minus 1 AR. Every other line is limited by both shared budgets.
maskhouse.wildNotice: Wilds land only on reels 2–4. They substitute regular symbols and have ×2 or ×3. On paid spins all wilds on one reel share the first landed wild multiplier. Multipliers of wilds in one paid line are added; no wild means ×1. Wilds stay in their cells during free spins. A bonus requires a BONUS on each of reels 1, 3 and 5.

lecipher.activationTokenNotice: At most one visible activation token. Initial cells are generated column-major from top to bottom. Before a token appears, regular/scatter/token weights apply. Once a retained or newly generated token exists, token weight is excluded from all remaining initial/refill draws; no ticket is rerolled. Collection reward cells are not activation tokens. A new free spin starts a new grid.
lecipher.legendaryNotice: Only four freshly drawn x10 clovers occupying one 2x2 square in a single collection can exceed the ordinary whole-round 30x budget or the ordinary free-spin budget (Luck 3.5x; Gold/Treasure 3x). Retained pots cannot satisfy the condition. The visible square awards the remaining amount up to 40x base stake minus 1 AR. No hidden jackpot ticket is drawn.
lecipher.goldenNotice: Luck keeps gold until collection; Gold and Treasure keep gold throughout the bonus. Treasure guarantees an activation token every spin and cannot be bought. Clovers multiply orthogonally adjacent coins/pots; pots collect all other coin/pot values top-to-bottom then left-to-right. A pot restarts the gold reveal. All tables and the whole-round cap are Indictus rules.

rareTailProof.boundType: Exact rational union upper bounds for standard House paid/sticky and LeXof paid/luck/gold generated attempts only; new feature variants are outside these bounds. Not exact cap frequencies or a universal guarantee about accepted rounds.

house.TWeights: Sum of9 independent picks with weights1:72,2:26,3:2;9<=T<=27; no retrigger; paid-launch wilds are not sticky.

lexof.interpretation: A specified2x2 square qualifies only when all four cells are fresh x10clovers from the same collection. Gold/activation selection cannot increase the conditional collection reward probability: both reward tables are separately, independently drawn after the eligible fresh cells have been chosen. Fixed pots are fresh:false and never qualify.

bodyBudgetConditions: Only actual visible declared legendary conditions may exceed the ordinary whole-round budget.
The explicit5%equivalent-purchase minimum is below the body budget and cannot independently reach the hard cap.
No account, balance, house reserve or prior result changes fixed tables.
Full possible maximum is reserved before RNG even if its upper tail is extremely rare.
limitations: These are upper bounds, not equalities or estimated exact hit frequencies.

Bounds describe generated attempts. Engine safety-limit exceptions reject without charging and are not silently retried; conditional probability among accepted rounds would additionally require an acceptance-probability bound.
